tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa bzhugs/ karma pa bdun pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad/

༄༅// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// lam pa'i spong ba'i sems kyi sdom med kyang*// 'bras bur gyur pa spangs pa'i zag med sdom// gang la mnga' ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// de yi chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// phyag 'tshal nas ni sdom pa gsum po dag /rgyal ba'i mdo dang rgyud sde las gsungs pa// bka' brgyud mchog las brgyud pa ji bzhin du// mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'dir bshad bya yi nyon// 'dir sdom pa gsum mdor bsdus te bshad pa la gnyis/ bshad srol ji ltar byung ba dang*/ bshad pa dngos so// dang po la gsum/ rgya gar ba'i lugs kyi bshad srol bod du byung ba dang*/ bod gzhan gyi lugs/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i bshad srol lo// dang po ni/ rgya gar ba'i lugs bod du 'gyur ba la/ a bha yā ka ra'i thub pa dgongs rgyan las 'byung ba dang*/ bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i 'od phreng las 'byung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gser gyi rgyan gser du rigs gcig kyang*/ mgo rgyan dang rkang gdub lag gdub sogs tha dad pa bzhin du/ sdom pa gsum po spong ba'i sems par rigs gcig kyang*/ sdom pa gsum tha dad par gsal bar bshad do// bi bhu tis ni/ skar ma dang zla ba nyi ma gsum gyi dpes zla ba shar ba na/ skar 'od zil gyis mnan nas bag la zha bar 'gyur ba dang*/ nyi ma shar ba na zla 'od kyang zil gyis mnan nas bag la zha bar 'gyur kyang*/ nyi zla skar gsum tha dad pa bzhin du/ sdom pa gsum po yang gong ma gong ma thob pas/ 'og ma 'og ma zil gyis mnan nas/ bag la zha bar gyur kyang ngo bo tha dad par bshad do// gnyis pa bod kyi lugs la sna tshogs pa 'dug kyang*/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong bas/ rgyud 'bum par/ rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag ni// bzhugs pas gser dngul zangs lcags 'gyur// gser 'gyur rtsi yi rang bzhin gyis// thams cad gser du bsgyur ba bzhin// so so thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yang*// dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs na// rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya'o// zhes 'byung bas/

gser 'gyur gyi dpes/ sdom pa gsum gnas gyur ngo bo gcig par bshad ces rjes 'brangs rnams kyis 'dod cing*/ sdom gsum rab dbyer/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa la// nyan thos theg chen lugs gnyis yod// ces bshad nas/ bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i// cho ga nyan thos lugs bzhin gyis// so so thar pa rigs brgyad po// theg chen so so thar par 'gyur// zhes sogs kyis gnas gyur par bstan par 'di'i rjes 'brangs rnams kyis 'dod cing*/ theg chen so so thar yin yang*// dge slong la sogs sdom pa yi// ldog pa shi ba'i tshe na gtong*// zhes sogs ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad par 'dod do// sdom gsum rnam gzhag pas/ li lder sogs snod shin tu dngas pa la/ chu dngas pa blugs pa'i nang du/ rin po che ind+ra nī la bzhag pa na/ snod chu sogs kha dog sngon por 'gyur bas/ ind+ra nī la'i yan lag tu 'gyur kyang*/ de gsum tha dad pa bzhin du/ cho ga rigs tha dad pas thob pa'i sdom pa gsum po mi gcig kyang*/ gong mas zin pa na/ 'og ma yan lag tu 'gyur ba yin te/ byang sa las/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i phyogs gcig nyid du rig par bya'o// zhes sogs bshad pa shes byed du 'dren par byed do// gsum pa bka' brgyud rin po che'i bshad srol la/ mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu'i thar pa rin po che'i rgyan las/ theg dman gyi so thar sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa na/ byang sems kyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims su 'gyur bar gsungs pa ni/ theg chen rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims su 'gyur ba ni ma yin te/ gal te yin na/ theg chen gyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims theg dman so thar gyi cho ga las thob dgos pas khyab par 'gyur ro// de ltar na/ theg chen pa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims la theg chen rang gi sde snod nas 'byung ba'i cho ga med par 'gyur na/

de yang mi rigs te/ theg chen gyi byang sdom la rang thob byed kyi cho ga rgya cher dngos su 'byung ba'i phyir ro// des na thar rgyan las de bzhin 'byung ba ni/ sems bskyed dang sdom pa gong mas zin pa na/ gang zag de byang sems su gyur pas de'i rgyud kyi sdom pa yin zhing*/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa ma yin la/ sems bskyed dang gong mas zin pas theg chen pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa yin pas/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims su 'gyur ces pa yin zhing*/ theg chen rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin par gsungs pa ma yin no// mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu'i gsung 'bum gyi nang du 'byung ba'i sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag gzhan las ni/ sdom pa gsum ngo bo tha dad/ bsrung na 'chol par bsrung*/ 'dom thug byung na gong ma gtso che/ yon tan yar ldan yin/ gtong thob tha dad/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ni gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi thugs bzhed yin no// gnyis pa bshad pa dngos la/ de ltar lugs tha dad pa du ma byung kyang*/ 'thad pa'i phyogs ni bka' brgyud rin po che'i lugs 'di yin la/ de nyid 'chad pa la gsum/ 'dir bshad kyi sdom pa gsum ngos 'dzin pa/ so so'i thob tshul/ sdom pa'i ngo bo gcig dang tha dad dpyad pa'o// dang po ni/ so so thar pa la yang theg dman dang theg chen so thar gnyis las/ 'dir ni theg dman gyi so thar dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la yang*/ dman pa'i byang chub kyi sdom pa dang*/ byang chub chen po'i sdom pa gnyis las/ 'dir ni byang chub chen po'i sdom pa dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang so so las thob pa'i sngags sdom gsum ni/ 'dir bshad par bya ba'i sdom pa gsum yin no// gnyis pa ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ so thar rigs brgyad so so'i rang gi thob byed kyi cho ga ji ltar bshad pa bzhin las thob cing*/

len pa'i yul kyang mkhan slob dang dge 'dun las sogs pa las thob pa'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ bod kyi sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi cho ga dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs kyi cho ga tha dad par 'dod kyang*/ thogs med sku mched nas brgyud pa dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras las brgyud pa'i cho ga'i khyad par yod kyang*/ de gnyis dbu sems kyi cho ga'i tha dad yin pa'i nges pa mi 'dug go /byang sdom ni/ rang thob byed kyi cho ga las thob pa yin cing*/ yul kyang sdom pa nyi shu par/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes bla ma'am jo bo chen po rje sogs kyi mdun du sangs rgyas byang sems rnams nas len par bshad pa ltar/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems las len no// sngags kyi sdom pa la bya spyod rnal 'byor sogs rgyud sde 'og ma'i sdom pa ni/ rang thob byed rgyud sde 'og ma'i dbang bskur so so ba las thob cing*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba las thob pa yin no// len pa'i yul kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du len pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ sdom pa'i ngo bo nyan thos bye brag smra ba rnams ni/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su 'dod la/ theg chen pas ni/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las// tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad// ces spong ba'i sems la bshad pas/ sdom pa gsum rim gyis nod pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu'i rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum po la sngar bshad pa ltar/ bod kha cig gis gnas gyur ngo bo gcig par 'dod kyang*/ gnas gyur ba dang ngo bo gcig pa 'gal ba yin te/ dper na gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags gser du bsgyur ba na/ lcags dang gser gnyis gcig pa ma yin pa bzhin dang*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes me long lta bu'i ye shes su gnas gyur pa'i tshe na yang*/

kun gzhi dang me long lta bu'i ye shes gnyis ngo bo gcig pa ma yin pa bzhin no// ngo bo gcig pa la gnas gyur du'ang mi rung ste/ lcags dang gser gnyis ngo bo gcig na gnas gyur mi dgos pa bzhin no// gal te gnas ma gyur pa'i dus su ngo bo mi gcig kyang*/ gnas gyur nas ngo bo gcig pa yin nam snyam na/ gnas gyur pa ni gser gyi ngo bor gyur pa yin pas/ de la lcags kyi ngo bo med pas ngo bo gcig pa'i gnas med do// gal te gnas gyur na lcags gser ngo bo gcig na/ gnas ma gyur pa na yang lcags gser ngo bo gcig dgos par 'gyur ba bzhin no// sdom gsum rnam gzhag pa'i lugs kyi sdom pa 'og ma gong ma'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhes zer ba ni/ sdom pa 'og ma gnyis kyang sngags sdom gyi yan lag tu byas pa nas/ 'og ma ma thob pa dang btang ba rnams la ni/ gong ma'i yan lag ma tshang zhing btang bar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod cing*/ sdom pa 'og ma gnyis kyang gong ma'i yan lag yin pas/ gong ma'i thob byed kyi cho ga las thob dgos par 'gyur la/ de ltar na/ sngags sdom nyid las sdom pa gzhan ma yin pas sngags sdom las ngo bo tha dad par mi rung la/ gtong thob tha dad pa'ang mi 'thad do// gzhan yang gong mas ma zin pa yan lag ma yin yang*/ zin pas yan lag tu 'gyur bas skyon de dag med ce na/ zin pa'i sdom pa 'og ma btang ba na gong ma'i yan lag btang bar 'gyur ro// des na/ a bha yā ka ras kyang*/ spong ba'i sems pa tsam du rigs gcig kyang*/ sdom pa gsum ngo bo tha dad par bshad cing*/ bi bhū tis kyang tha dad par bshad pa ltar/ rgya gar ba'i lugs gang las kyang gnas gyur ngo bo gcig par bshad pa dang*/ 'og ma gong ma'i yan lag tu bshad pa sogs ma byung ngo*// des na/ sdom pa gong ma ma thob pa'i tshe/ theg dman nas 'byung ba'i so thar gyi sdom pa ni/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa yin kyang*/ byang sdom thob nas sems bskyed khyad par ba dang*/

sdom pa gong mas zin cing rten gyi gang zag byang sems kyi rgyud kyi sdom pa yin pas/ so thar gyi sdom pa ni thun mong ba'i sdom pa dang*/ byang sdom thun mong ma yin par 'gyur la/ sngags sdom thob pa'i tshe sngags kyi sems bskyed/ sdom pa khyad par bas zin cing*/ rten gyi gang zag rig par 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi sdom pa yin pas/ sdom pa 'og ma gnyis ka thun mong bar 'gyur zhing*/ sngags sdom thun mong ma yin par 'gyur ro// de la srog gcod spong ba lta bu sdom pa gsum ka yin pa'i spong ba'i sems pa ngo bo gcig pas/ sdom pa gsum ka ngo bo gcig par 'gyur ro snyam na mi 'gyur te/ srog gcod spong ba dang ma byin len spong ba lta bu spong sems tsam du ngo bo gcig kyang*/ de gnyis tha dad pa ltar/ spong ba'i sems pa gcig la cho ga tha dad las thob pa'i thob tshul tha dad pas sdom pa gsum yang tha dad pa yin no// de ltar sdom pa gsum tha dad yin pa yang*/ gang las 'byung ba'i theg pa dang*/ sde snod mi gcig par tha dad/ gang las len pa'i yul mi gcig /len byed kyi cho ga mi gcig /len pa'i dus mi gcig /len pa'i bsam pa dang sems bskyed mi gcig /gtong rgyu dang gtong ba'i dus mi gcig /rten gyi gang zag mi gcig ste/ so thar sdom pa ni/ theg dman dang nyan thos kyi sde snod las 'byung la/ byang sdom ni/ theg chen gyi dang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las 'byung zhing*/ sngags sdom ni/ 'bras bu'i theg pa'am rdo rje theg pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin sde snod las 'byung bas so// len pa'i yul mi gcig ste/ theg dman so thar ni/ mkhan slob dge 'dun la sogs pa yin la/ byang sdom ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems las len cing*/ sngags sdom ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha las len pas so// len byed kyi cho ga yang*/ so thar ni/ rang gi 'bogs chog karma sha taṃ la sogs las 'byung ba lta bu las thob la/

byang sdom ni/ theg chen gyi 'dul ba'i sde snod las 'byung ba'i cho ga las thob cing*/ sngags sdom ni/ dbang bskur ba las thob pas so// dus mi gcig ste/ dus so sor blangs pas so// bsam pa dang sems bskyed mi gcig ste/ so thar ni/ 'khor ba las rang nyid thar 'dod kyi bsam pa dang*/ dman pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin cing*/ byang sdom ni/ 'gro ba thams cad byang chub chen po thob par bya ba'i bsam pa dang*/ theg chen gyi byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa yin la/ sngags sdom ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don gcig car du bsgrub pa'i bsam pa dang*/ rdo rje'i sems bskyed pa yin pas so// gtong rgyu so sor mi gcig pa bshad pa ltar la/ gtong ba'i dus kyang so thar gyi sdom pa ni/ bsnyen gnas mtshan mo 'das pa dang gzhan rnams 'chi 'phos pas gtong ba sogs ni khas blangs dus kyis btang ba yin te/ so thar gyi sdom pa ni/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i sdom pa yin pas so// byang sdom yang ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa tshun chod zhes pa yin pas/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar mi gtang ba'i phyir/ byang chub thob nas gtang ba'i don ma yin no// sngags sdom yang de dang 'dra'o// sdom pa gong ma gnyis la gtong rgyu gzhan ma byung bas gtong ba med do// rten gyi gang zag kyang mi gcig ste/ so thar kho na'i sdom ldan ni/ nyan thos yin la/ byang sdom thob nas byang sems yin cing*/ dbang thob nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sngags pa yin pas so// 'di'i dbang du mdzad nas rgyud 'bum par/ rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag ni// bzhus pas gser dngul zangs lcags 'byung*// zhes sogs sngar drangs pa nyid gsungs pa yin te/ rdo'i rigs gser rdo dang dngul rdo sogs kyi bye brag bzhus pa las/ gser dngul zangs lcags tha dad du 'byung ba bzhin du/ so thar byang sdom sngags sdom gsum rang rang gi thob byed kyi cho ga las thob cing*/

ji ltar thob pa'i rim pas/ so thar kho na rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de la/ nyan thos zhes bya la/ byang sdom rgyud ldan de la byang sems zhes bya la/ sngags sdom rgyud ldan la sngags pa rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ba tha dad du 'byung ba yin te/ gser 'gyur rtsis gser du bsgyur ba ltar/ sngags kyi dkyil 'khor ched po 'dir zhugs nas sngags sdom thob pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi nyan thos byang sems zhes bya ba'i gang zag de la rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya'o// zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ sdom pa gsum gnas gyur pa'i don ma yin no// spyir khyim pa dang rab byung gnyis las/ so thar rigs brgyad la bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen tsam gyi sdom ldan ni khyim pa yin la/ rab tu ma byung na dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa ldan kyang*/ khyim pa'i rtags can yin pas 'jig rten brdar btags kyis khyim pa'i phyogs su gtogs so// gzhan yang sngon dge slong mang po dad zas kyi nyes dmigs mthong nas bslab pa phul bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs so zhes gsungs par bshad pa de dag dang*/ khyim bdag grags pa rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gang yang ma thob par dgra bcom thob pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// zhes bka' stsal pa lta bu yang*/ rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i dge slong ngam/ don gyi dge slong yin yang*/ khyim pa dang rab byung gnyis kyi ni khyim pa yin te/ 'jig rten brdar btags kyi dbang du byas pa'o// theg pa chen po las byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi le'u las/ khyim pa dang rab byung gi phyogs gnyis bshad pa la/ byang sems ni sems can gyi don rnam pa sna tshogs sgrub pa'i slad du khyim pa mang ste/ dper na byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs sogs dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i cha lugs can rnams khyim pa rab byung gnyis kyi khyim pa yin kyang*/

don gyi rab byung dang dge slong yin no// sngags pa la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyang yin la/ sngags pa yang yin pa ni/ sngags pa rab byung yin la/ rab tu ma byung pa ni sngags pa khyim pa yin no// bya rgyud dpung bzang la sogs las/ rgyal ba ngas gsungs so so thar pa yi// tshul khrims rnam dag sdom pa ma lus pa// sngags pa khyim pa'i rtags dang cho ga spangs// lhag ma rnams ni nyams su len par bya// zhes gsungs pa ni/ sngags kyi dbang bskur las thob pa yin pas/ sngags sdom yin gyi so thar gyi sdom pa ni ma yin no//

bsrung na 'chol par bsrung ba ni/ so so nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du so thar gyi sdom pa tshang ba dran shes bsten nas bsrung zhing*/ gong ma gnyis kyang ji ltar so sor bsrung ba la 'chol bsrung ces bya'o// 'dom thug ni gzhan gyi don du snying rje'i srog gcod pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ brdzun la sogs pa nges par dgos shing*/ de dag ma spyad na byang sdom 'chor la/ spyad na so thar 'chor ba lta bu yin te/ de lta bu gong ma gtso che la/ de yang gzhan gyis dge slong la/ pham pa byung zer ba sogs kyis 'phya ba yod na/ bslab pa phul nas spyad par gsungs la/ 'phya ba med na bslab pa ma phul kyang 'og ma nyams pa'i pham pa 'byung ba sogs kyi skyon zil gyis mnan nas mi 'byung zhing*/ gong ma gtso che bas gzhan don du srog gcod pa bya dgos pa lta bu'o// yon tan yar ldan ni/ 'og ma'i pham pa byung ba sogs la'ang nyes pa med par sems bskyed dang*/ gong ma'i sdom pas zin pas srog gcod pa sogs kyang rdzogs sangs kyi rgyu'i bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba ni yon tan yar ldan no// gtong thob tha dad pa ni brjod zin to// de ltar rje rang byung bas kyang*/ sdom pa gsum po de yon tan yar ldan 'og ma'i skyon zil gyis gnon/ sngags sdom rgyud ldan la so thar nyams nas med pa ma yin ces pa'i don kyang gong du bshad pa bzhin no// bye brag tu sngags sdom thob pa'i mtshams la rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'dzin pa'i brjod pa tha ma la rigs lnga'i sdom pa tsam zhig thob cing*/ de bsrung ba gzhir bcas rim gnyis so so'i skabs kyi dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa thob pa la dbang bzhi mtha' rten sogs cho ga cha lag tshang ba las thob pa'o// zhes pa rab zab rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang*// skal dman blo zhan rnams kyis rtogs dka'i don// sa bcu'i dbang phyug zla 'od gzhon nu dang*// rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod 'chang ba// sems dpa' rang byung rdo rjes legs phye ba/

gang la brten nas chos grags rgya mtsho yis// bskul ba po rnams 'dod pa rdzogs phyir du// sdeb sbyor spangs nas go bde mdor bsdus pa// bris pa'i sdom gsum rnam gzhag nyes bral dge// rdzogs sangs 'gro ba kun gyis thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa bkra shis zur mangs nas bla ma nam mkha' rdo rjes dgos zhes/ chos grags rgya mtshos kong yul gsa' phur bris pa'o// zhes so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/
